item.title: Ibaraki 3-Day Trip: Oarai Aquarium, Mito Kairakuen Plum & Tsukuba Wanwan Land (March 2024)
item.description: In early March 2024 we crossed Ibaraki Prefecture from the Pacific coast toward Tsukuba. Day 1: Hitachinaka Seaside Railway and harbor-town air, then Aqua World Ibaraki Oarai—sharks, sunfish, and deep-sea exhibits. Day 2: Mito—Mitogaku Road, the natto monument, and Kairakuen in plum season, plus Lake Senba where we caught Train Suite Shiki-shima stopped for photos. Day 3: Tsukuba Wanwan Land with dog shows and meet-the-breed zones. Spring Ibaraki packs sea, history, blossoms, and animal parks into a short hop from Tokyo.

item.title: Ibaraki Travel Guide: Aqua World Oarai, Kairakuen Plum & Tsukuba Wanwan Land (2024)
item.description:
Ibaraki works as a day trip from Tokyo, but combining Oarai (aquarium & sea), Mito (Kairakuen & Lake Senba), and Tsukuba (Wanwan Land) covers ocean, a famous garden, and a hands-on dog park in two or three days. Late February–March is plum season; Kairakuen gets crowded.
